study: DISCo collective query coverage in organizational memory
notes: Negative pilot result. The lexical-coverage proxy did NOT outperform TF-IDF+MMR or BM25 at complete evidence@10; no official DISCo or neural baseline was run. Synthetic labels contain unresolved temporal ambiguities. No production or paper-level superiority claim is justified.

rows.role: Preregistered lexical comparator; NOT neural dense retrieval

provenance: Synthetic dataset SHA-256 e9bfd73fb33762b7a4f7364eb1941e52e96bdd27bf6b061a5a90221138e176a0; CPU rerun-5 under frozen preregistration rev 6; 10 tests passed; 48 held-out collective queries; independent read-only aggregation replay.
limitations: Exploratory template-based synthetic pilot; score aggregates verified against saved query rows, not independent raw ranking replay. Temporal gold ambiguity and template cues; no human annotation; 24 project-family clusters in the held-out sample; unequal word/token budgets and compute; no official DISCo, neural dense baseline, ANN or indexing experiment; lexical coverage proxy loses to BM25 and MMR.
dataset_integrity: structural checks passed: unique ids, label containment, session chronology, family split, generator reproducibility
verification_scope: Saved CPU-pilot results independently checked by recomputing category aggregates from per-query CSV and rerunning 10 unit tests; evidence label validity, neural retrieval, and algorithm equivalence remain unverified.

primary_comparison.decision: Fails preregistered +3 percentage point threshold with lower CI bound > 0

posthoc_robustness.method: Independent aggregate replay, 10,000 paired family-cluster bootstrap resamples; exploratory, NOT preregistered
